reviews.comment: Difficult exams. Not great lecture info provided. Very hard to maintain high grade.

reviews.comment: I worked all semester to maintain an A, only to have it dropped to a B at the very last second due to one quiz and a participation discussion that isn't even clearly visible on Canvas. Concerns? Dismissed. Flexibility or empathy? Zero. If you value fairness, think twice before taking this class, because you will not be shown grace for anything!

Seems like it was his first time leading a course, had to buy two 3rd party apps + McGrawhill and barely used one. Power tripped and changed the final to cumulative 4 weeks before we took it and didn't send an announcement about it. Only good part is that the exams are a lot like the quizzes/hw, but overall minimal effort once again from Mays. :)
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Given that this is an asynchronous course, it is pretty much self-taught and I think that is the problem that most people have here. He tried to communicate often and was available by office hours throughout the week. He also posts some helpful videos. Exam questions are usually very similar to homework problems.

It's a self-taught course. He's a grad student, so I blame the university for not getting a proper prof and lectures. That said, you have to teach everything yourself, so if you haven't mastered that ability, I would not take this class with Minki. If you can learn from the textbook, reverse engineer the problems, and memorize, you'll get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This is by far the WORST class I've taken at A&M. Kim doesn't post any help at all. You are literally paying for the class and three separate homework platforms to teach yourself EVERYTHING. He is completely useless as a professor. This class needs some serious restructuring.

reviews.comment: Honestly, worst class I have taken in my life. Not to mention, worst "professor" to ever "teach" a class. He is not even a professor and does not provide the appropriate resources for the class and you basically teach yourself. He sent out a homework correction error the day it was due which is inconsiderate to the max. DO NOT TAKE.

We pay money on top of tuition to learn from a textbook and use a paid discussion board once. The teacher does not teach. This class is a bad stain on MAYS.

Give us an actual professor who will post some videos helping us learn what will be on the quizzes and tests. The passing grade of C starts at 64... I wonder why.

reviews.comment: This class seriously isn't that bad... at all You have 1 HW assignment per week and it is so easy to find help for them online. He lets you have a cheat sheet for every quiz and exam so as long as you're organized it's an easy A. I personally have not had to communicate with him so I had no issues. If you're generally an A-B student you'll be fine.

Grad student taught all online course. The only material to learn form is an online book which you have to highlight and comment on to start discussions. The whole book is covered.
